name_en: Reclined on one arm, leg raised against kneeling partner
description_en: The female figure reclines on her back propped on one arm, torso turned toward the camera, with one leg lifted straight up against the male's torso and the other bent under. The male crouches on one knee over her hips, resting a hand on his raised knee and holding her raised leg close to his shoulder, showing off her chest, the long raised leg and the open hips.

front.view: three-quarter front; her raised leg crosses in front of the male, chest toward camera, foot above his shoulder

high.view: from above and behind her head-side; hips and raised leg prominent, chest partly hidden by her arm

low.view: near floor level; chest and raised leg clear, male looming behind

side.view: profile; she leans on forearm, raised leg leans on the male who kneels on both knees

diag.view: diagonal front; raised leg and chest visible, her hips partly hidden by the male

notes: Male posture varies between views (one-knee crouch vs both knees in side view). Faces are blank mannequins.

name_en: Standing from behind, hand on hip, looking back
description_en: Standing with weight on one leg, the other foot back on the toes, one hand on the hip and the torso twisted so the figure looks back over the shoulder. The pose shows off the buttocks, long legs and the curve of the back.

front.view: figure seen from behind (mislabelled front); buttocks and back toward camera, head turned back

high.view: from above, rear three-quarter; buttocks and breast side visible

low.view: from below behind; legs and buttocks dominate, raised heel soles visible

side.view: rear three-quarter profile; chest and buttock curve both in view

diag.view: rear diagonal, similar to side with slightly more chest

notes: All five views show the figure mostly from behind; front is actually a back view.

name_en: Standing relaxed, hand at neck, other hand on thigh
description_en: Standing with feet apart and weight slightly shifted, one hand touching the neck and the other resting on the upper thigh. The torso faces the camera, showing the chest, hips and legs openly.

front.view: straight front, full figure open to the camera

high.view: steep top-down; chest and head dominate, arm extended toward the camera

low.view: steep worm's-eye; legs and feet large, chest foreshortened above

side.view: true profile facing left; chest and buttock curve in silhouette

name_en: Bent over at the waist, arms hanging
description_en: Standing with legs apart and the torso folded far forward at the hips, head low and both arms hanging toward the floor. The pose presents the rear and hips toward the back and the hanging chest toward the front.

front.view: from the front; head and hanging chest between the arms

high.view: from above behind her; back and rounded hips dominate, head tucked between the arms

low.view: from low front; wide legs and large feet, chest hanging between the arms

side.view: true profile facing left; hips high, torso hanging forward

diag.view: front diagonal; torso folded down with both arms hanging beside the legs

notes: Front and low views are from the front; the high view is from behind/above showing the back. Solo, only loosely mimics a position.

name_en: Standing salute with hand on hip
description_en: Upper-body standing figure with one arm raised in a salute to the forehead and the other hand resting on the hip. The torso is upright and the bust and waist are shown off in a playful, confident stance.

front.view: straight-on front; salute arm raised at left, hand on hip at right

high.view: from above, head foreshortened and bust prominent

low.view: from below, chin raised, bust and torso elongated

side.view: profile; bust silhouette, salute arm in front of face, hand on hip

diag.view: three-quarter front; bust and raised arm visible

name_en: Hand behind head, cupping one breast
description_en: Upper-body standing figure with one arm raised and the hand behind the head while the other arm crosses the torso to cup a breast. The raised arm exposes the armpit and the bust is emphasised.

front.view: front; raised arm exposes armpit, hand cups the near breast

high.view: from above, head tilted and chest prominent

low.view: actually from behind: shows the back and neck, with the hand wrapping round the side of the breast

side.view: profile; breast silhouette and raised arm with armpit visible

diag.view: three-quarter front; cupped breast and raised arm

notes: low view is mislabelled and shows the figure from behind

name_en: Leaning forward on forearms, cupping breast
description_en: Upper-body figure resting on forearms on a surface, likely lying prone, with the head lowered and one hand cupping a breast. The large bust is pressed forward and shown off toward the camera.

front.view: front at surface level; forearms on the floor, hand on breast, hip curve visible at right

high.view: from above, head bowed over the bust

low.view: from low, large bust dominates, chin tucked

side.view: profile; upright torso, bust silhouette, forearm across the front

notes: lower body mostly cropped; support inferred from the ground line and the hip at the right in the front view
